main.description: Internal — fired by refreshVesselMaster.bpmn (R/PT24H). Backfills vertex_vessel.flag_iso (from vessel_flag_iso UDF) and dimensions for rows missing them, using accumulated AIS Type-5 broadcasts. Also derives type_class via vessel_type_class UDF for any rows where type_code was updated. Open-data only (no paid IHS / VT Explorer enrichment per ADR-2605011500).

limit.description: Max vessels to refresh per fire (default 5000, max 50000).
